bio.text: Allen Treadaway is a Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 51, first elected in November 2006.
According to his legislative profile, he was born September 25, 1961, and retired in October 2020 as assistant police chief of the City of Birmingham.
The profile lists him as a past president of Birmingham Fraternal Order of Police Lodge 1 and says he and his wife Susan have five children.
